description: For one of the user's CVs: whether verified recruiters can find it on TakeMeUp, which recruiters asked to contact the user (and their status), and how many recent views. Free. Use when the user asks about recruiter interest.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: get_takemeup_get_found
title: Get found: recruiter visibility
